data.title: Business Development Intern (w/m/d)

data.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location with regular travel to client sites across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You own the client outcome on our largest strategic accounts, from the moment the contract is signed to the moment the solution is running at scale, and you carry the revenue that comes with it.

Our customers do not buy software, they buy a change in how their organization runs. Automating core processes end-to-end frees capacity that was locked in manual execution. Consolidating fragmented point solutions onto one platform lowers what the process landscape costs to own. And running those processes with full transparency gives finance something it rarely has, a reliable real-time view of what is actually happening, which is what makes forecasting and financial steering possible.

Delivering that on a strategic account takes a full blp team: a Senior Project Manager and Project Managers, Integrations Engineers and a Technical Project Manager, a Consultant with AI Automation Specialists, and our Customer Success Engineers. Your job is to make that team deliver for your customers, to hold the relationship at executive level while it happens, and to grow the account once the value is proven. You make sure a strategic customer gets what it was promised: a custom Academy for its teams, priority support, and whatever automation effort it takes to reach the productivity we committed to.

You are not managing a queue and you are not running the project plan. You carry a focused portfolio of our largest customers, and you are the one person accountable for whether they consider blp a success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own net revenue retention and expansion across a focused portfolio of our largest strategic customers.

  • Join late-stage commercial discussions, shape the delivery approach with the Account Executive, and own the client kick-off.

  • Hold the steering committee seat and the relationship with the client's CFO, COO or Head of Shared Services.

  • Act as the trusted advisor and domain expert your clients call before they call anyone else.

  • Orchestrate the functions that serve your accounts, project management, integrations, consulting and support, without managing them directly.

  • Own the value case: set the baseline at go-live, track it, and defend it in the quarterly business review.

  • Be the first point of escalation for your clients. Call a delivery review when a project is off track, require a recovery plan, and hold the organization to it.

  • Identify expansion early, new entities, new processes, new countries, and build the internal case for it.

  • Be the voice of your customers inside blp: collect and structure product feedback from your accounts, and work with Product, Engineering and Sales to translate what clients need into what gets built, without losing sight of blp's own product direction.

  • Turn your best accounts into reference customers: case studies, referenceability, and clients willing to speak publicly about blp.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Ownership Without Authority – You deliver a number that depends on people who do not report to you, and you do it without escalating.

  • Executive Presence – You hold a room where a client executive is unhappy, and you leave it with a decision rather than an action item.

  • Commercial Instinct – You see the expansion before the client asks, and you can build the business case for it.

  • Structured Thinking – You break an ambiguous client situation into a plan with owners and dates.

  • Customer-First Mentality – You care about the client's business outcome, not about defending the project scope.

What You Bring

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 6+ years of experience in strategy consulting, enterprise customer success or account leadership, or senior delivery roles with commercial accountability.

  • Proven track record of owning senior client relationships in complex, multi-stakeholder organizations.

  • Experience running steering committees and holding difficult conversations with executive sponsors.

  • Credible on enterprise finance and supply chain processes. You do not need to configure an ERP, but you need to understand how one is used.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for experience in ERP, AP automation, or AI-driven enterprise SaaS.

How You Grow

Client Partners work closest to our leadership and to our largest customers. From here the paths lead into leading a team of Client Partners, into senior commercial roles, or into leading a delivery or consulting function. Many of our Client Partners come from Senior Project Manager or Senior Consultant roles, and we are explicit about what that step requires.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Career Path in Consulting

Our Consulting team has a clear path, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the impact you have had, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • AI Automation Specialist: Hands-on in the automation itself: you tune agents, run automation sprints and take your first own customers end to end. Typically you bring up to 2 years of experience.

  • Consultant: You own a portfolio of live customers as their run lead, including health, growth and account economics. Typically you bring 3+ years in consulting, process improvement or ERP process ownership.

  • Senior Consultant: Our most complex and sensitive accounts, at executive level, and you coach the Consultants and Specialists around you. Typically you bring several years of leading process change at customers.

  • Next steps: Lead a Consulting team, or become a Client Partner on our strategic accounts.

Moves into Project Management or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Your Mission

For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where our Consulting team sits.

Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organization that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Our job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own.

This is also where our AI meets the real world, and the real world is messy. When a customer goes live, our agents start processing their documents: invoices, order confirmations, delivery notes, in dozens of formats from thousands of suppliers, with layouts nobody has seen before. Most of it works immediately. The rest is where we come in.

A concrete example. Our AI learns a customer's business logic from their own history. By reading how they have accounted invoices in the past, blp infers the rules they have been applying and makes them explicit. Sometimes it cannot close the loop on its own, because the same kind of invoice was historically booked in two or three different ways and there is no consistent rule to find. In those cases blp asks. It needs the answer once, and every future case follows it. Making sure that answer arrives, and that it is the right one, is our job. Done well, each of those conversations builds trust and removes a category of manual work permanently.

As an AI Automation Specialist

You are hands-on in the automation itself. You configure and tune the agents so they work for a specific customer, dig into exceptions until you find the actual cause rather than patching the symptom, and run automation sprints: the push after each go-live to the target automation rate, and focused sprints our customers book to take their automation further.

You are in front of customers from early on: running the sessions that explain what a new capability does, taking the open questions our AI raises to the person who can decide them, and chasing down why automation is not landing, whether that is a master data problem, a habit, or a process rule that no longer makes sense. You use data-driven insights to decide which conversations to have with customers and which improvements to prioritize.

You work alongside a Consultant on your accounts and build process and platform depth on real customers from the first month.

Key Responsibilities

Automation and performance

  • Configure and tune agents so they work for a specific customer's documents and processes.

  • Drive and own the push after each go-live, from first live volume to the target automation rate, and deliver the automation sprints our customers book.

  • Resolve the open questions our AI raises about a customer's business logic: take the cases to the customer, get the decision, and make it permanent.

  • Drill into root causes when automation stalls, and tell a master data problem from a process rule from a behavior.

Customer health and growth

  • Own customer health across your portfolio, measured first and foremost by automation rates.

  • Act as run lead and escalation point for your customers once they are live.

  • Challenge process rules that prevent automation, and drive improvements with the department leads who can decide.

  • Enable the customer's core team to resolve issues themselves, and reduce what has to come to us at all.

  • Spot expansion opportunities and bring in Sales, and work alongside the Client Partner on strategic accounts.

Account economics

  • Secure and monitor service consumption against the agreed budgets.

  • Scope automation sprints and additional services, and make sure paid work is billed.

Team and platform

  • Work with our Customer Success Engineers on technical topics, and feed recurring patterns back to Product.

  • As a Consultant, direct the AI Automation Specialists working on your accounts.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this team:

  • Process Excellence – You understand core business processes, P2P and O2C, and you can see why a process is shaped the way it is and what it could look like instead.

  • Client Hands – You bring customers with you. You are strict on the things that matter and flexible on the things that do not.

  • Pattern Recognition – You notice that thirty exceptions are really one problem.

  • Comfort in the Data – You go into the numbers yourself to find where automation is leaking.

  • Ownership – You see a job through, and you take a customer from live to high automation without being told the steps.

  • Growth Mindset – You learn fast, ask when you are stuck, and get better every month.

What You Bring

For the AI Automation Specialist level

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Strong career changers are equally welcome.

  • Up to 2 years of professional experience. Internships, working student roles or a first analytical job count.

At every level

  • Confident in front of customers, from operational teams to their leadership.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for experience with ERP systems, accounts payable or order management processes, data skills such as SQL or Python, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 20,000+ daily active users, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

 

About the role

We're looking for a driven, curious, and impact-focused Senior Account Executive to join our growing team. You'll play a key role in driving revenue growth across mid-market and enterprise accounts by helping organizations automate their ERP processes with AI. At blp, you'll take full ownership of the sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation and close, and directly shape how the next generation of companies operates.

You'll engage with senior decision-makers (CFOs, CIOs, CPOs, COOs) to uncover challenges, design tailored solutions, and position blp's platform as a strategic enabler of efficiency and insight. You'll work closely with marketing, product, and customer success to deliver exceptional value throughout the customer journey.

 

What you'll own

Pipeline creation and territory strategy

  • Build and execute a territory/account plan: target accounts, stakeholders, sequencing, and multi-threading strategy.

  • Create net-new pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner motion, events, and customer referrals.

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and forecasting, and report proactively on progress, risks, and what you need from the organization.

Insight-led selling and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing and introduce a sharper point of view on where value is trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls).

  • Run executive discovery to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate it into a crisp target-state narrative, urgency, and mutual action plan.

  • Build internal alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees, including champions, economic buyers, IT/security, and process owners.

Commercial ownership: value case, negotiation, and close

  • Own the business case, pricing strategy, proposals, negotiation, and contracting.

  • Quantify and communicate value (capacity release, cycle time reduction, control/compliance improvements, stack simplification) and tie it to executive priorities and budget.

  • Drive the deal to closure with clear next steps, strong deal governance, and accurate forecasting.

Orchestration across presales and delivery

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers to run workshops/demos and de-risk technical concerns (security, integration, rollout).

  • Align with Customer Success on implementation readiness, success criteria, and expansion paths.

  • Ensure clean handoffs from close to kickoff, maintaining continuity of value narrative and outcomes.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Anticipate and neutralize competitive plays with crisp differentiation and proof.

 

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 5–10+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS selling experience (or equivalent complex solution sales), with a consistent track record of hitting/exceeding targets.

  • Proven ability to run insight-led enterprise sales cycles: you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and mobilize buying committees.

  • Strong executive presence with CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services and comfort navigating enterprise procurement.

  • Ability to manage complex, multi-threaded deals: mutual action plans, MEDDICC-style qualification, forecasting discipline.

  • Strong collaboration with presales/SE and post-sales teams; you sell what can be delivered.

Strong plus

  • ERP/SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or selling into finance/procurement/shared services transformations.

  • Experience selling automation platforms (workflow/RPA/process mining/IDP) and winning against incumbents.

  • Experience with global enterprise rollouts and multi-country stakeholders.

Language

  • Fluent in English and German (or another major European language depending on territory).

 

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

  • Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

  • Continuous learning. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to help you excel.

  • Exceptional team. Join a group of ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to achieve excellence.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team


Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions.

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

 

About the role

As a Senior Manager within our AI Safety team, you’ll lead delivery across our AI Safety portfolio, focusing on frontier model evaluations and crucial crossover work with our customers in the Government & Public Services space. This is a strategic role working alongside peers to shape the commercial delivery of our AI Safety projects in the UK

You’ll serve as the primary link between clients and our dedicated data scientists to translate cutting edge AI safety research into actionable changes as well as model red teaming and safeguard testing with labs like OpenAI and Anthropic into strategic, impactful solutions.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Overseeing, and providing thought leadership on, the delivery of novel and complex AI safety evaluations and red teaming projects for clients.

  • Forming strong, trusting relationships with customers, internal safety data scientists, and technical partners, including frontier labs.

  • Developing and executing compelling proposals to grow our AI safety and governance work across a wide range of sectors.

  • Advising clients on AI safety strategy and technical implementation, acting as a trusted partner and consultant.

  • Mentoring and developing team members, aligning their responsibilities with the fast-growing and important AI safety domain.

  • Supporting wider delivery work as a Senior Manager when needed business to ensure maximum strategic flexibility and commercial impact.

 

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You bring proven experience or a passion for Applied AI safety, possibly from labs, academia, or evaluation/red teaming roles.

  • You understand the commercial consulting delivery model, allowing you to focus immediately on account growth and project oversight.

  • You can effectively bridge the gap between highly technical AI safety research and strategic business challenges, communicating complex ideas clearly.

  • You are excited by the opportunity to join a globally leading team in the fast-growing and vital AI safety ecosystem.

  • You possess the flexibility to support broader senior manager work and embrace an entrepreneurial approach to a highly visible portfolio.

  • You thrive in ambiguous settings and demonstrate a structured approach to problem-solving and delivering high-quality, high-stakes projects.

 

The Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (60 minutes)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Culture and Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

#LI-PRIO

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

About the team

 

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

data.description:
About Edra

Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations.

We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. We're a deeply technical team of engineers, AI researchers, and strategists with a high bar for talent and a shared belief that exceptional people are the foundation of everything great we'll build.

The Role

We're looking for a Founding Product Designer to join our team and shape the experiences our customers interact with every day. You'll work across the full design process—from early research and ideation through to polished, shipping designs—collaborating closely with engineering, product management, and other stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Own design for key product areas, taking ambiguous problems and turning them into clear, elegant solutions

  • Conduct user research to understand needs, pain points, and how people actually use what we build

  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces to explore and validate ideas

  • Partner directly with engineers to bring your work to life–and iterate based on what you learn once it ships

  • Contribute to our design system and establish patterns that scale across the product

What We’re Looking For

  • You have 5+ years of experience designing digital products, with a portfolio that demonstrates end-to-end product thinking (not just visual polish)

  • You're proficient with modern design tools (Figma or equivalent)

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and energized by open-ended problems where the right solution isn't obvious yet

  • You can advocate strongly for your ideas while remaining genuinely open to feedback and debate

  • You're curious about how people use the things you build--not just whether the designs look right, but whether they actually work

  • You have some familiarity with user research methods and front-end development constraints, even if those aren't your primary strengths

Don’t meet all of the above traits? We’d still love to hear from you. We’re looking for exceptional people with unique skills and interests, and we know that great people have different backgrounds and skillsets.

  • Watch our Series A announcement video

Edra offers generous compensation and benefits in both New York & London:

We work together in person five days a week from our offices in the West Village (New York) and Holborn (London).

data.description:
What we are building at Conveo

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

 

#1 What problem are we solving, and why is this an important problem to solve

The current/traditional research methods companies rely on are slow, expensive, and superficial. Running great research also requires expertise, which is a blocker to many companies. That directly affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them.

 

#2 The team you will join

You will join an extremely talented team of incredibly passionate, high-energy people. We go the extra mile while having the best time of our lives. Our team has the combination of decades of market research knowledge, incredible engineering ability, and experience building companies.

 

#3 How we operate

  • We truly care about our clients and the problem we solve. That means we humbly go the extra mile every time.

  • We work hard, and we have fun.

  • To keep our quality bar incredibly high, we want to execute with the smallest possible team.

 

The Role

As a Sales Director at Conveo, you’ll take full ownership of the sales cycle — from building pipeline to closing enterprise deals and expanding accounts. You’ll partner directly with the founders to refine our go-to-market strategy while landing and growing some of the world’s biggest brands. This is a high-impact role where you’ll navigate complex orgs, multi-stakeholder deals, and long sales cycles ($45K-$500K+), selling into industries like CPG, Pharma, Tech, and Financial Services.

 

Your Mission

1. Create Demand & Build Pipeline

  • Own a defined ICP and territory plan, executing multi-threaded outreach (email, LinkedIn, calls).

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads with crisp discovery and problem framing.

  • Build and maintain 4–5× pipeline coverage to hit and exceed quota.

2. Win Deals & Expand Accounts

  • Lead consultative discovery and run tailored demos tied to customer workflows and KPIs.

  • Navigate complex buying committees (economic buyer, users, procurement, legal) and manage deal timelines.

  • Negotiate and close clean, scalable contracts; expand initial wins into multi-market, multi-year agreements.

3. Be the Market & Product Expert

  • Translate customer pain points into compelling ROI cases.

  • Stay on top of competitor moves and market trends to sharpen messaging and objection handling.

  • Capture customer success stories and proof points that strengthen Conveo’s market narrative.

4. Partner with Founders & Marketing

  • Provide structured product feedback to shape roadmap priorities.

  • Collaborate on campaigns, content, and sequences to boost funnel conversion.

  • Maintain crisp CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Qualified pipeline coverage (≥4–5× quota), stage velocity, and win-rate improvements.

  • Strong win rates (high stage-to-stage conversion, clean qualification/disqualification, and rising expansion (multi-market/multi-year, increased ACV & ARR ).

  • Referencable customers and repeatable plays we can roll out across the team.

 

What we’re looking for

  • 5–15 years of enterprise sales in SaaS, Martech, or Market Research.

  • Track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals (ACV $75K+) with long sales cycles.

  • Experience selling to Fortune 500 companies.

  • Great if you have a strong network or background in market research, insights, or consulting.

  • High energy, self-motivation, and a relentless drive to win.

  • Excellent communication skills — active listener, persuasive storyteller, and trusted advisor.

  • Comfortable with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce) and multi-channel outreach.

  • Team player who thrives in a fast-paced, low-politics, high-standards environment.

 

Why join us

At Conveo, you’ll join a team that genuinely enjoys working and spending time together. We care about building real relationships, not just great products. That’s why we run quarterly team off-sites where we disconnect, reset, and have fun. Our next one is a retreat in the Alps this March.

 

Plus

  • Own attention for a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company.

  • Direct access to founders and high-leverage operators.

  • Help define how AI-powered research becomes the global default.

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside.

  • A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition.

  • Opportunities to travel globally and build real relationships with customers shaping the future.

Why loveholidays?
At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

We’re using progressive tech to drive cutting-edge innovation and open the world to everyone. Within our Commercial and Support teams, you'll find a place to accelerate your growth by actively seeking learning opportunities and carving your own path. You'll create impact for our future by owning projects and shaping the business strategy to reach shared goals, all within our enhanced international community of collaborative and passionate teams.


About the team:

The Payments function has been recognised as a strategic area for the business, with the capacity to significantly impact key metrics: conversion rates, cost reduction, compliance, customer satisfaction and retention.

The Senior Payments Manager at loveholidays will report into the Head of Payments and will have the opportunity to influence the future structure of the team as it continues growing.

Given the cross-functional nature of payments, you will work very closely with the dedicated Product and Engineering functions responsible for Payments, as well as a multitude of internal and external stakeholders.

The impact you’ll have:

The role will be primarily responsible for establishing new and managing existing commercial relationships with our payment providers, agreeing new contracts, improving terms and conditions and ensuring they are able to offer us the products, features and services we need so we continue to meet customer needs across markets and across the different payments touch points:

  • New, as part of the checkout journey

  • Scheduled, between having booked and travel, when customers have opted for a payment plan

  • Customer, when customers make ad-hoc payments through our app or the Manage My Booking portal.

The Senior Payments Manager is an expert in the Payments Industry with in-depth knowledge of the different aspects of this industry: commercial, product, technical, regulatory, and will support - and deputise for - the Head of Payments in guiding the company through key decisions as we expand internationally.

In addition, this role is also responsible for maximising the incentive generated by payments on VCCs when paying direct suppliers.

Your day-to-day:

  • Manage day to day relationships with our payment partners, and be a key liaison between internal and external.

    • Manage the process to sign new or amend existing agreements

    • Negotiate pricing

    • Run weekly calls, QBRs, identify and track areas of opportunity

    • As Admin of these accounts, support internal controls to minimise risks.

  • Working closely with key internal stakeholders, combined with your in-depth knowledge of the industry and experience in previous similar roles, provide recommendations in terms of how to further optimise our customer payment operations, whilst ensuring alignment with the organisation's overall objectives.

  • Build robust relationships with business owners in Managing, Selling, and Scaling operations. The Senior Product Manager - Payments will be a key ally.

  • Keep the company informed of compliance with local and international regulatory requirements.

  • Support the Head of with the forecast, budget and actual monitoring of payment processing fees, which is the largest component of the Variable Costs line in our P&L.

  • Stay up to date with industry trends and innovation, bringing this knowledge in-house and raising internal awareness of changes in this area.

  • Stay up to date with competitor offerings in terms of payments, steering the company through ways to differentiate ourselves.

  • Leverage relationships with external technical suppliers, vendors and partners to align them with our own goals and get the most out of our agreements

  • Manage and improve the operational efficiency of our VCC supplier payments, maximising acceptance and incentives.

  • Teach the company about the payments industry, key trends, evolution, and the impact it could generate in the business if done right, or wrong!

Your skillset:

  • Track record in managing Payments commercial relationships, negotiating and improving terms.

  • Knowledgeable in the payments ecosystem, main stakeholders and drivers, not only for card payments but also for alternative forms of payments, ideally across Europe.

  • Outstanding commercial insight and be able to identify and realise business opportunities.

  • Extensive network and ability to find the answers for any unknown elements.

  • Experience in building best in class payments journeys, balancing great customer experience whilst reducing costs and keeping fraud in check.

  • Ability to translate how the company works and what it needs to external partners in order to find solutions to our needs.

  • Due to the growth trajectory that loveholidays is on, it is fundamental that this candidate has previous experience within a fast paced/high growth business – for example, sectors such as FMCG, e-commerce or technology.

  • Relentless attention to detail

  • Hands on as required and very diligent to continue to drive value accretion.

  • Detailed understanding of what good looks like in terms of process and reporting.

  • Excellent organisational and leadership skills.

  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal abilities.

Desirable:

  • Previous travel experience is an advantage.

The interview journey:

  1. First stage with Talent - 30 mins

  2. Second stage with Head of Payments - 60 mins

  3. Third stage: Case study

  4. Final stage: VP Commercial Finance - 45 mins

  • Company pension contributions at 5%.

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up.

The Account Executive, Strategic, is responsible for managing and expanding relationships with key strategic accounts. This role involves a deep understanding of the client's business, the ability to develop strategic plans to increase revenue, and ensuring client satisfaction through excellent service. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in sales, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to navigate complex negotiations.

Responsibilities

  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships with strategic clients. Act as the main point of contact and advocate for client needs within the company.

  • Strategic Business Planning: Develop a thorough understanding of key client needs and requirements. Work closely with clients to devise and implement strategic plans that align with their business goals and drive mutual growth.

  • Sales Targets: Achieve and exceed sales quotas within assigned portfolio by identifying and closing business opportunities.

  • Market Analysis: Conduct research and analysis to understand industry trends, competitive landscape, and client feedback to inform strategic planning and identify new business opportunities.

  • Reporting and Forecasting: Provide accurate forecasts and track key account metrics. Report on the status of accounts and transactions, and monitor sales performance against goals.

  • Contract Negotiation: Lead contract negotiations, ensuring favorable terms for both the client and the company.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience selling to large, complex F100 businesses, demonstrating a successful track record of meeting or exceeding targets, preferably in a similar industry or role.

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence credibly and effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.

  • Experience delivering client-focused solutions to customer needs.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple account management projects at a time while maintaining sharp attention to detail.

  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Above and beyond: Trained in Command of the Message and MEDDPICC

What to expect

  • Relationship Building: Begin to establish relationships with key internal stakeholders, including sales, marketing, product, and customer support teams. Understanding their roles and how they can contribute to the success of strategic accounts is crucial.

  • Client Familiarization: Start to get acquainted with the portfolio of strategic accounts, including reviewing account histories, previous interactions, and current contracts or agreements. Initial meetings with some key clients may also take place to introduce yourself as their new point of contact.

LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.


Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.


What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.


With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity.

About the role

Nigeria is LemFi’s primary growth driver. Right now, we move money for millions of Nigerians living in the UK, US, and EU. As Head of Nigeria, you will be the single accountable commercial leader owning our largest corridor end-to-end—driving growth strategy, revenue and pricing levers, product positioning, and cross-functional execution across three distinct regional corridors (UK, US, and EU). You will lead the evolution of LemFi from a pure remittance provider into a comprehensive financial platform.

What you'll build and own

  • Define and execute the growth strategy for UK, US and EU (Nigeria), treating each corridor with the distinct approach its maturity demands - defending our market-leading remittance position, while leading the shift to a multi-product financial platform in the UK; and accelerating top-of-funnel customer acquisition, capture market share, and scale remittance corridors from early-stage to maturity in the EU and US.

  • Own the Nigeria revenue line end-to-end: take rates, pricing decisions, partnership structures, routing optimisation, and revenue targets across every product line.

  • Identify how to bundle, package, and position our full suite of financial products in mature markets to drive customer lifetime value and cross-product adoption.

  • Build, recruit, and lead a team across multiple markets and functions - growth, partnerships, operations - setting direction, developing talent and holding the bar high from day one.

  • Act as the connective tissue between Nigeria growth and the rest of LemFi: align with treasury, product, data, finance and cross-functional GMs to remove blockers, secure reliable infrastructure and make sure the team has something worth selling.

  • Translate field intelligence into strategy: spend time with real users, challenge your team's assumptions in the market, and bring ground-level insight back into the planning cycle - not just data from a dashboard.

  • Leverage AI tools to sharpen analysis, stress-test market growth assumptions, and execute market reviews with speed and rigor.

Your experience

  • 10+ years of experience in Fintech / Neobanking / Financial Services, or 6–7 years of relevant and deep experience in cross-border payments, remittance, or multi-product consumer fintech)

  • Proven track record owning a P&L or revenue line in a fintech business - you know how remittance and financial services economics work and can read a take-rate problem without being walked through it.

  • Experience leading a function or market that spans multiple geographies or corridors at different stages of maturity - you know what good looks like at scale and what it looks like on day one.

  • Background managing marketing or growth budgets in the range of one to three million dollars a month, with direct accountability for the results.

  • Comfortable working across the full commercial stack: growth and acquisition, pricing and revenue, partnership development, product positioning and customer retention.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead diverse, distributed teams and develop people who are themselves highly autonomous - you build capability, not dependency.

  • Demonstrated ability to align cross-functional teams—Treasury, Product, Data, Finance, and Operations—behind commercial targets without needing formal authority.

Nice to have

  • Experience growing a multi-product financial app beyond its original category (e.g. moving a payments or remittance product into savings, credit or banking).

  • Familiarity with the Nigerian diaspora market in the UK, US or EU - either from lived experience or from having worked directly with that customer segment.

  • Exposure to early-stage market building in the US or continental Europe alongside a mature home market.

Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down. Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. This is not a traditional product engineering role - it's built for engineers who want their work to directly shape outcomes for Synthesia's most strategic customers and partners, often within days, not sprints.

You'll be embedded in high-value customer engagements, working alongside Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success to design, build, and ship bespoke technical solutions that unlock use cases no off-the-shelf feature could address. You'll own the full arc - from a whiteboard conversation with a customer's CTO through to a working, deployed integration - and you'll do it fast.

This role is for engineers who are super scrappy, fast-learning, and ambitious - people who might not pass every bar of a traditional product engineering process but who consistently find creative ways to get things built and shipped in the real world.

What You'll Do

  • Work directly with Synthesia's most strategic customers and partners to design and build bespoke technical solutions that unlock high-value use cases on their behalf.

  • Own the full build cycle for custom engagements: from scoping and architecture through to delivery, with a bias toward speed and impact over broad reusability.

  • Bridge technical and business stakeholders - equally fluent in conversations with engineers and architects as with senior decision-makers on the customer or partner side.

  • Translate ambiguous customer requirements into working prototypes and production-grade solutions in tight timelines.

  • Partner with internal product and engineering teams to feed real-world customer needs back into the product roadmap.

  • Identify patterns across customer engagements and help define where bespoke builds should become platform features.

  • Represent Synthesia's technical capabilities confidently and credibly in customer meetings, workshops, and discovery sessions.

What We're Looking For

The mindset matters more than the CV

You don't need to have worked at a particular company or passed a particular interview loop. What we care about is how you operate:

  • Bias for action. You build before asking permission. You ship something scrappy to test a hypothesis before writing a spec.

  • Rapid learner. You pick up new tools, APIs, and customer contexts quickly - and you enjoy the discomfort of operating at the edge of what you know.

  • Customer instinct. You naturally ask "what problem are they actually trying to solve?" before writing a line of code.

  • Commercially aware. You understand that speed of delivery is a form of value. You make tradeoffs that a product engineer might not - and you own the consequences.

  • Communicator. You can run a technical deep-dive with an enterprise architect in the morning and explain your approach to a CPO in the afternoon.

Experience signals we look for

  • Experience building and shipping working software - the form it took matters less than the fact you've owned something end-to-end.

  • Comfort working across the stack or with APIs and integrations to deliver solutions quickly.

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

Almost any company can produce training video at scale today. Almost none can tell you whether it actually made someone better at their job. We're building the product that closes that gap: an agentic, real-time experience where people practice live, dynamic scenarios, and where organizations finally get genuine signal on readiness, instead of a metric tied to course completion. This is a zero-to-one bet on what comes after content, which is practice, and proof.

You'll own one of two of the domains inside that bet, Surveys and Guidance, from strategy through ship.

Why now

Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it.

The problem you're solving

Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal.

We have the underlying technology to change that. What we need is a product manager who can turn it into something an enterprise will use to prepare its people, and that an end user actually wants to engage with, across two connected domains:

  • Surveys - capturing structured, trustworthy signal at scale: how people feel, how they're performing, and where the gaps are.

  • Guidance - giving people direction in the moment they need it, live and in context, rather than as a debrief after the fact.

Both sit inside the same bet: give organizations proof of readiness, not just proof of attendance.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the multi-quarter strategy for Surveys and Guidance, setting the direction, identifying the right problems to solve, and making the trade-offs needed to deliver against them.

  • Defining and evolving the success metrics for both domains, and connecting product outcomes directly to commercial results: retention, expansion, and revenue impact.

  • Getting close to the customers who matter most: understanding how they think, where current tools leave them exposed, and translating that into a product direction others can act on.

  • Driving a shared understanding of where these product areas are going and why. Engineering, design, R&D, and commercial counterparts should all be able to articulate the strategy and the reasoning behind it.

  • Producing written narratives, strategy docs, and PRDs, that move decisions forward and give your team the context to build the right thing without a follow-up conversation.

  • Balancing short-term delivery with long-term product health: scoping to reflect execution risk, hitting milestones predictably, and iterating based on evidence rather than opinion.

  • Contributing to improvements in product practice across the team, and actively participating in PM hiring.

Who you are

You've owned a critical product domain before, one where the stakes were real and the strategy was yours to set, not just execute. You're comfortable operating with autonomy on the what, not just the how, and you have a track record of connecting product decisions to commercial outcomes.

You understand that zero-to-one products in complex domains require you to hold two things at once: the discipline to deliver predictably in the short term, and the judgment to make the right long-term bets while the evidence is still forming. You don't wait for a clean brief. You identify the right problems, form a view, and bring others along.

You're a strong written communicator. Engineering and design partners, commercial leads, and senior leadership should all come away from your docs and updates with a clear understanding of where the domain is going and why, without needing to ask.

You care about the quality of the experience. Real-time, agentic products are unforgiving, and you hold a high bar for what "good" feels like, for the user in the moment and for the customer looking at outcomes.

You may be a good fit if you bring

  • Significant experience in product management, with direct experience owning a critical product domain: setting strategy, not just executing it.

  • A track record of connecting product outcomes to commercial results: ARR, retention, expansion, or equivalent.

  • Experience with zero-to-one product development in a complex, experience-driven space. You've navigated the ambiguity of a zero-to-one build and have the scar tissue to show for it.

  • Experience building agentic or AI-powered products. You understand what makes real-time AI interactions feel natural, and what breaks them.

  • Strong written communication: strategy docs, PRDs, and decision memos that others can act on without a follow-up conversation.

  • Experience working alongside enterprise buying motions. You'll be close to the commercial team, and that context matters.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. Strong candidates rarely match a list exactly, and we'd rather hear from you.

Location

Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

 

Global benefits:

  • You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity.

  • You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.

  • Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person.

  • Work from home budget

  • Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year

  • Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater - our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit)

 

Benefits specific to UK:

  • Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants

  • 5% pension match

  • Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the office

  • Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage.

  • Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control.

  • Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them.

  • Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities.

  • Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest.

  • Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step down from development.

  • Production experience building test infrastructure, developer tooling or internal platforms that other engineers depend on — designed and owned, not just extended.

  • Hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks: prompt and context design, tool use, handling non-determinism, and evaluating output quality. This is the differentiator for the role.

  • Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing.

  • The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLM systems.

  • Open-source contribution experience.

  • Java, TypeScript or Python; Kubernetes and Helm.

  • Background in developer tooling or platform engineering.

This role is an existing vacancy

What We Have to Offer:

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Title: Director, EMEA Insights

Status: Hybrid

Department: Global Insights

Location: UK Office

Reporting Relationship: VP, Global Insights

Position Summary

e.l.f. Beauty is looking for a Director, EMEA Insights to join our dynamic, fast-paced, high-growth company. The ideal candidate will have a consumer and community-first mindset with a strong background in executing consumer research and synthesizing market data to analyze and articulate consumer trends and business impacts. This person is highly self-motivated, inherently curious, and strategic yet detail-oriented, with a passion for analyzing data, surfacing insights, and storytelling with data to drive business decisions.

The position will report directly to the Vice President, Global Insights. 

The Director, EMEA Insights is responsible for overseeing the EMEA-focused market and consumer insights functions, including market analysis, competitive intelligence, product insights, consumer research, audience segmentation, trends, and foresight, to drive actionable, data-driven growth through compelling storytelling. This individual will be adept at connecting dots across multiple data sources and strategically distilling and disseminating those actionable insights to all levels in the organization. This individual will be a thought leader and work collaboratively with cross-functional partners, acting as the voice of the EMEA consumer in making strategic connections between broad-based trends and marketplace opportunities. The ideal candidate is data-driven, results-oriented, has excellent communication skills, and is comfortable operating across all levels of the business, from strategic to tactical.

This position is based in e.l.f.’s London office with a hybrid 3-day in office schedule.

Responsibilities:

  • Strategically distill insights from diverse data sources and present them to senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams in a compelling narrative with concise and actionable findings and implications.
  • Leverage multiple data sources to connect dots and develop a comprehensive understanding of the business environment including brand performance, competitive brands and products, social dynamics, consumer behavior, demographic/audience factors, and macroeconomics, keeping a pulse on consistently evolving trends and foresight within and beyond beauty. Disseminate insights and strategic recommendations throughout the organization at all levels.
  • Leverage syndicated data tracking resources (e.g. NielsenIQ, Circana, Euromonitor, WGSN, Shopper Insights, Mintel, Spate, GfK) for frequent analysis of trends and identifying whitespace opportunities.
  • Lead the evolving EMEA consumer profile and audience segmentation initiatives across the brand portfolio.
  • Analyze social media conversations and trends, translating to actionable recommendations for marketing teams.
  • Own end-to-end creation of Insights presentations (e.g., PowerPoint), i.e., from storyline through final edits.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders in brand, innovation, digital, creative, sales, and Integrated Marketing Communications functions, surfacing insights and analytics to further promote and enable consumer-centric, data-driven decision-making in EMEA markets.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with external data and research partners (NielsenIQ, Circana, Mintel, YouGov, etc.), while consistently evaluating potential new data and research partners.
  • Drive the exploration and implementation of innovative research, trend tracking and social listening methodologies, including AI, to create next generation insights approaches and methodologies.
  • Partner with US-based Global Insights team to connect dots and unify insights that drive the business.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in consumer research, market analysis, and data insights and analytics, inclusive of experience leading a multi-disciplinary consumer and market insights team.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Marketing, or a related quantitative field. A master's degree or MBA is a plus.
  • Strong ability to analyze and synthesize disparate information from multiple data sources into a holistic story with strategic implications and recommendations. Capable of turning complex information into simple and understandable messaging.
  • Adept at designing and executing multi-country end-to-end quantitative and qualitative consumer research (i.e., survey development, discussion moderation), with the ability to generate relevant and actionable insights connected to consumer needs and business strategies.
  • Experience with multiple types of custom research, including positioning, segmentation, innovation concepts, advertising/concept testing, consumer journeys, path to purchase, brand health tracking, etc.
  • Outstanding ability to navigate syndicated data sets (e.g., NielsenIQ, Circana, Euromonitor, GfK, Shopper Insights) beyond pulling numbers, to analyze and distill the most relevant insights.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to work independently and effectively across multiple projects, without sacrificing accuracy and attention to detail, in an extremely fast-paced environment.
